display_name: OpenAI — ChatGPT subscriptions and Codex credits
_comment: The other half of the native baseline. Codex writes rate_limits into its
own transcript on a token_count event, so this route reads a file the
agent already wrote rather than receiving a push or dialling anything.
This is the one axis set with a committed capture of a real session, so
it is the manifest that shows what live-verified means here: the
evidence is a recording, not a fixture.

redaction.note: The rate_limits block itself carries no credential or personal datum; the allowlist is the block's own key set at schema v3, so a field Codex adds later is reported rather than absorbed silently.

fixtures.name: token-count-rate-limits
fixtures.note: Copied verbatim out of the committed 2026-08-18 codex recording named in the evidence below.

billing_mode.note: plan_type was 'plus' in the recorded session.

quota_windows.note: primary carried used_percent 68.0 over a 10080-minute window with an absolute reset. Measure is unset: this route reports a percentage, never an absolute used/limit pair.

balance.note: The credits block is present and parsed, but the recorded account reported has_credits=false and balance "0". Deliberately claimed one rung below what the recording would earn: no non-zero balance and no currency has been observed through this route, so calling it live-verified would overstate what was seen.

account_identity.note: RateLimitSnapshot.ConfirmedAccountRef has no producer on this route.

evidence.note: A committed recording of a real codex session whose token_count events carry rate_limits.
